Chongxiu Fengshan xianzhi (重修鳳山縣志) - Fengshan county gazetteer, southern Taiwan
Date: 1764. NOT VERIFIED from a title page; conventional date.

Transcription: Chinese Wikisource
https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/重修鳳山縣志
revision id 2269205 (2023-03-19T07:36:44Z) [250,011 chars]
Retrieved 2026-08-30.

柑子蜜（形如彈子差大，和糖可充茶品）
"shaped like a pellet, somewhat larger; with sugar it can serve as a tea item"
A SIZE DATUM: 如彈子差大, about the size of a pellet and a little bigger - a
small round fruit, consistent with the cherry/currant class rather than a
large ribbed tomato.
番柿（形似柿，實有毛，俗呼為毛柿。西域種） the velvet apple, NOT the tomato

CAUTION: Wikisource text is in SIMPLIFIED characters - a modern typeset edition.
